description: Identify the real part Re(z) or imaginary part Im(z) of a complex number given in algebraic form a+bi. Multiple-choice exercises.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math textbook, Chapter 1 (complex numbers, algebraic form) — exercises only
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-25

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given the complex number } z = 7+2i. \text{ The real part of } z \text{ is: (a) } Re(z)=7 \quad \text{(b) } Re(z)=-7 \quad \text{(c) } Re(z)=2 \quad \text{(d) } Re(z)=-2 \quad \text{(e) another answer}
exercises.technique: Definition of real part: for z=a+bi, Re(z)=a.

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given the complex number } z = 5-4i. \text{ The imaginary part of } z \text{ is: (a) } Im(z)=5 \quad \text{(b) } Im(z)=-5 \quad \text{(c) } Im(z)=-4 \quad \text{(d) } Im(z)=4 \quad \text{(e) another answer}
exercises.technique: Definition of imaginary part: for z=a+bi, Im(z)=b.
